headline: Rayhound mount
title: Rayhound | Double Jump Electric Mount | Palworld Guide
video_script: Rayhound is a fun early mount in Palworld one point zero. You can ride it, and it can double jump while mounted. Its partner skill adds five to twenty five percent movement speed for each other Electric Pal in your party. It also works as an Electricity level four generator at your base. Will you build an Electric team? Comment below!
description: Rayhound in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Electric Pal with a double jump and a speed bonus from Electric party mates.
